facts.business: Hindoostan Mills Limited operates an Engineering Division manufacturing calender rolls and calender machines for technical textiles and packaging industries, having discontinued its textile division in 2025.
key_risks: Pending labour cases pertaining to discontinued textile division with unascertainable outcome
Legal cases against or pursued by the company involving high management judgement for provisioning
Discontinued operations resulting in losses (Rs 555.29 lakhs loss in FY2026)
Asset held for sale classification for plant, machinery and land of textile division
